title_en: New Slang, New Stories (7/20): "So Emo Today" on WeChat Moments
note_en: In Chinese slang, the English loanword emo works like an adjective or even a verb: 今天好emo "so emo today," 别emo了 "stop being emo," 谁emo了 "whoever's feeling emo." Notice how it slots into normal Chinese grammar: 好 and 有点 before it like any adjective, and 了 after it to show a change of state.
